diagram_previews.alt: Isosceles triangle ABC with base AB horizontal, the 36 degree base angles marked with arcs and labelled, and the obtuse apex C at the top. The blue incircle with centre I sits above AB; the grey circumcircle has its centre O below AB. A red dashed segment joins I and O, crossing AB at its midpoint, showing that O is the mirror image of I.
